content.hebrew: מִמְּקוֹמוֹ מוֹפִֽיעַ כָּל־עִנְיָן, אַדִּיר וְנָאוֹר;
content.transliteration: Mimmeḳomo mofi’a‘ kol ‘inyan, addir vena’or;
content.english: From His place, He brings every matter to light—He, the noble and luminous One;

content.hebrew: אֹמֵר וְגֹמֵר, מַבְדִּיל בֵּין חֹֽשֶׁךְ לְאוֹר.
content.transliteration: Omer veḡomer mavdil ben ḥoshekh le’or.
content.english: He speaks and decrees definitively, and distinguishes between darkness and light.

content.hebrew: לְקַיֵּם דְּבָרוֹ, מֵעִיר לֵב עִקֵּשׁ לֵאוֹר –
content.transliteration: Leḳayyem devaro, me‘ir lev ‘iḳḳesh le’or –
content.english: In order to fulfill His word, He awakens the heart of the crooked to be illuminated—

content.hebrew: קהל: וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם, וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאוֹר.   (בראשית מא:א)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ufar‘o ḥolem, vehinnē ‘omed ‘al hay’or
content.english: Cong. And Pharaoh was dreaming, and behold, he was standing at the river. (Gen. 41:1)

content.hebrew: אַשָּׁף וְכָל־חַרְטֹם – אָמַר לְהָבִיא כֻלָּם,
content.transliteration: Ash’shaf vekhol ḥartom – amar lehavi khullam,
content.english: Magician and sorcerer—[Pharaoh] said to bring them all,

content.hebrew: יְסַפֵּר לָהֶם חֲלוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָלַם;
content.transliteration: Yesapper lahem ḥalom asher ḥalam;
content.english: He told them the dream that he had dreamed;

content.hebrew: וְאֵין פֹּתֵר אֹתָם כָּרָאוּי, פְּרָטָם וּכְלָלָם,
content.transliteration: Ve’en poter otam kara’uy, peratam ukhlalam,
content.english: But none could interpret it properly, in its details or its general sense,

content.hebrew: קהל: אֵין אֹמֶר וְאֵין דְּבָרִים, בְּלִי נִשְׁמַע קוֹלָם.   (תהלים יט:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: En omer ve’en devarim, beli nishma‘ ḳolam.
content.english: Cong. There was no speech, and no words; their voice was inaudible.  (Ps. 19:4)

content.hebrew: הָזְכַּר יוֹסֵף – עִנּוּ בַכֶּֽבֶל רַגְלוֹ,
content.transliteration: Hozkar Yosef – ‘innu bakkevel raḡlo,
content.english: Joseph—[whom] they had persecuted by shackling his leg—was mentioned,

content.hebrew: וְהוּבָא לְפָנָיו, וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלוֹ,
content.transliteration: Vehuva lefanav, vayyishma‘ ḳolo,
content.english: And he was brought in front of [Pharaoh]; he heard his voice,

content.hebrew: וַיֵּֽדַע כִּי הָאֱמֶת בְּמִלּוּלוֹ,
content.transliteration: Vayyeda‘ ki ha’emet bemillulo,
content.english: And knew that the truth was in [Joseph]’s words,

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּֽבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ.   (בראשית מא:מג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishnē asher lo.
content.english: Cong. So [Pharaoh] had him ride in his second-level chariot.   (Gen. 41:43)

content.hebrew: רָעָב בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ גָּבָר,
content.transliteration: Ra‘av bekhol ha’arets gavar,
content.english: A famine overtook the whole land,

content.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף עֲשָׂרָה, לִשְׁבֹּר בָּר.
content.transliteration: Vayyerdu aḥē Yosef ‘asara, lishbor bar.
content.english: So Joseph’s brothers, ten [of them], went down to buy grain.

content.hebrew: כִּי מֵיוי הָיְתָה הַסִּבָּה לְעַם נָבָר,
content.transliteration: Ki me’Adonai hayetah hassibba le‘am navar,
content.english: For it was a cause from Adonai, for the blameless people,

content.hebrew: קהל: לְמַֽעַן סַבֵּב אֶת־פְּנֵי הַדָּבָר.     (שמואל ב יד:כ)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: lema‘an sabbev et penē haddavar.
content.english: Cong. In order to make the matter happen.  (2 Sam. 14:20)

content.hebrew: נוֹעַץ לְחַדֵּשׁ לָהֶם חֲדָשׁוֹת,
content.transliteration: No‘ats leḥaddesh lahem ḥadashot,
content.english: [Joseph] plotted, to invent new predicaments for them,

content.hebrew: כְּדֵי לְצָרְפָם. וַיָּֽשֶׂם אָזְנָיו לְדִבְרֵיהֶם חֵרְשׁוֹת.
content.transliteration: Kedē letsarefam. Vayyasem oznav ledivrehem ḥershot.
content.english: In order to test them. He turned a deaf ear to their words.

content.hebrew: וְהֵם לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי חָיוּ הָעֲצָמוֹת הַיְבֵשׁוֹת –
content.transliteration: Vehem lo yade‘u ki ḥayu ha‘atsamot hayveshot –
content.english: They did not know that the dry bones were alive—

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיִּתְנַכֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם קָשׁוֹת.   (בראשית מב:ז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayyitnakker alehem vaydabber ittam ḳashot.
content.english: Cong. And he acted as a stranger to them, and spoke to them harshly. (Gen. 42:7)

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ נֹתֵן חָכְמָה לַחֲכָמִים, וְנִסִּים עֹשֶׂה,
content.transliteration: Barukh noten ḥokhma laḥakhamim, venissim ‘osē,
content.english: Blessed is the One who gives wisdom to the wise, and performs miracles;

content.hebrew: מָעוֹז לַדַּל וּלְאֶבְיוֹן מַחְסֶה,
content.transliteration: Ma‘oz laddal ul’evyon maḥsē,
content.english: [He is] a stronghold for the indigent, and a refuge for the poor.

content.hebrew: רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן, לַעֲבָדָיו מְנַסֶּה.
content.transliteration: Risho ve’aḥaron, la‘avadav menasseh.
content.english: He is the first and the last, and He tests his servants.

content.hebrew: קהל:אֹמֵר עֲצָתִי תָקוּם וְכָל־חֶפְצִי אֶעֶשֶׂה.  (ישעיה מו:י)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Omer ‘atsati taḳim vekhol ḥeftsi e‘eseh.
content.english: Cong. He says: What I counsel will happen, and I shall do whatever I wish. (Isa. 46:10)

content.hebrew: חזן: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Cantor: Listen to Me, Jacob, and Israel who are called by Me: I am the first, and I am the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Congregation: Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
